sentences.en: What kind of mileage do you get on this thing?
sentences.zh: 这辆车能跑多少公里数？

sentences.en: My employer reimburses me for expenses like parking and mileage.
sentences.zh: 我的雇主会报销停车费和里程费。

sentences.en: My new car gets better gas mileage than my old one.
sentences.zh: 我新车的油耗比旧车好得多。

senses.zh: 英里数，里程,好处，利润,（按英里计算的）运费,〈美〉（公务员出差时）按英里支付的旅费
